# The Real Ownership Test - Can You Leave

## The Core Test
### The ability to leave within 72 hours
### Take all assets with you
### A clear transfer process

## A Sign of Dependency
### The answer is "no" or "I don't know"
### Not an asset, but a rental
### The illusion of ownership

## Typical Risks
### The domain is not in the client's name
### Control sits with the agency
### Problems during a sale
### Problems in inheritance

## Verifiable Ownership
### The domain is registered in the client's name
### The content belongs to the client
### Export upon termination
#### Website
#### Content
#### History

## Model Format
### A product principle
### Not an industry norm
### Not a legal standard
### 72 hours is a condition of the model

## Practical Conclusion
### Ask any contractor
### The answer needs to be specific
